sentences.text:
Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is filed praying that
 in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may
 be pleased to pass an order or writ or direction, more preferably one in the
 nature of a writ of mandamus declaring the action of the respondents
 especially respondent no.2 to 5 in demolishing dwelling houses of petitioners
 in Sy.No.180 of Apparaopeta Village, Akividu Maandal, West Godavari District
 as
 illegal, arbitrary without due process of law even without notice
 unconstitutional, violative of principles of natural justice, contrary to the
 provisions of the Right to fair Compensation and transparency in Land
acquisition. Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and violative of Articles
 14, 21 and 300- A of the constitution of India consequently direct the
respondents not to demolish the dwelling houses of the petitioners in
Sy.No.l80 of Apparaopeta Village, Akividu Mandal West Godavari District in
the house site pattas granted by the respondents without following due
procedure of law.
lA No: 1 Of 202R
 Petition under Section 151 Cpc is fiied praying that in the
circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High
Court may be pleased to direct the respondents not to interfere with the
peaceful possession and enjoyment of the petitioners' dwelling house
properties including removal of existing structures or houses in Sy.No. 180 of
 Apparaopeta Village, Akividu Maandal, West Godavari District without
 following due process of law, pending disposal of the Wp No.33227 of 2025,
 on the file of the High Court.
